column3: “At the end of the days” is rendered “in the last days,” and “at the head of” “as the chief of.”
“From his ways” is rendered “about His ways,” and “instruction” “the law”; NASB adds “Even.”
“To far away” is rendered “distant”; “beat” is rendered “hammer,” and “learn warfare” “train for war.”
“Dwell” is rendered “sit”; “there will not be one who terrifies” is rendered “With no one to make them afraid.”
“For” is rendered “Though”; NASB adds “As for us.”
NASB reverses “gather” and “assemble”; “done harm” is rendered “afflicted.”
“Migdal Eder” is translated “tower of the flock”; NASB adds “Even.”
“Shout shouting” is rendered “cry out loudly,” and “anguish” “agony.”
“Burst forth” is rendered “labor to give birth,” “town” “city,” and “open country” “field”; “delivered” is rendered “rescued.”
“They have gathered” is rendered “have been assembled,” and “look on” “gloat over.”
“Crush” is rendered “pulverize”; “I will dedicate to destruction” is rendered “That you may devote,” changing the person.
